title: Metron per-symbol close history (market_data/close_history/{yf_symbol}.json, schema_version 1)
description: Producer: collectors/metron_market_data.py::collect_history (CLOSE_HISTORY_SCHEMA_VERSION). Consumer: Metron portfolio_analytics/prices/spine_source.py (NAV reconstruction), api/services/data_spine.py. Plan §3 boundary table row 1. The consolidated CONSOLIDATED_CLOSE_HISTORY_KEY artifact shares this per-symbol row shape under `series`/`currency` maps.

x-settling-bar.rationale: market_data/close_history/consolidated.json holds each symbol's full close history as [date, close] rows under $.series.<sym>; the row dated the report's trading_day is that session's bar, which v1 fetches while the vendor is still settling it (alpha-engine-config-I11551, measured 2026-09-21..23: day-D rows differed on 57-60% of series at a median 2.3-2.8 bps while every earlier row matched exactly; v1's own next run re-fetched SIZE@2026-09-23 as the shadow's value). Only a NUMERIC move inside a row both sides date trading_day settles; the row's date, a series whose length differs (a missing or extra day-D row) and every earlier row stay strict, and the day-D rows are re-graded strictly on the next report's prior_day block. The per-symbol close_history/{sym}.json key is NOT named in row_dates and carries no settling bar.
